Episode 138. The Tower Keeper of the White Night (6)
As Sandra fell, she spread her arms wide and wore a full smile on her face.
To those who didn't know her background or circumstances, she looked like a person greeting a long-lost lover with a heartfelt emotion.
'That's... Sandra Gipfel...!?'
'Did she just call him... our Mr. Jin!?'
'Is there some kind of relationship between the 12th generation and Sandra Gipfel?'
Joshua, Dephus, and Jane couldn't help but widen their eyes as they looked up at Sandra.
Her sudden appearance and calling Jin 'hers' was absurd, and it was shocking to see the monstrous Hedo become instantly flustered by her words.
Click!
Sandra landed about ten steps away from Jin with agile and light movements, unlike a typical mage.
"Kyahaha, I thought you would catch me in a cool way. So you're going to dodge me like that?"
"There are people in the world for whom dodging is the best strategy."
"How about my outfit today? I got a special recommendation from the Golden Phoenix and had it custom-made. Is it okay?"
Jin focused on her golden prosthetic arm, rather than her black coat and shirt that resembled Runecandle uniform. He could also recognize the engraving of his face on the inside.
-It's a right arm... it seems just right.
-What do you mean, just right?
-It's still too early for you to take everything from me. A right arm is neither too much nor too little. We're on our first day of dating, after all.
The conversation they had in Gaipa Territory made him shiver once more.
The fighting stopped and all that could be heard for a while were the sounds of rubble and broken stone falling to the ground, and the alarm growing louder.
Jin just nodded his head.
It wasn't difficult. It actually suited his taste, and more importantly, it seemed like it would help them get out of this terrible crisis a little more.

"I'm glad! If you had deceived me, I would have slaughtered those cute rat-doll rat-soonies. I would have sent that stupid muscle pig... that damn muscle mass... that damned Hedo! What are you going to do about this, how will you take responsibility?"
Waaaaaaaaaah-!
The alarm was getting louder. Outside, the dragons of Drakka had already begun to fly, and the ship Cojack was preparing to sortie.
"You promised to have dinner with me!"
"...There was a slight hitch, Miss."
"A hitch? A hitch, you say! At this crucial moment, do you want to die for real? Do you know how long I've been waiting?"
The Runecandles couldn't understand it at all. It was too surreal to see that monster cowering so much in front of Sandra.
And at that point, Jin realized why Hedo had not "actively" attacked.
'It was because of Sandra's orders.'
His emotions became complicated.
The fact that he might have survived Hedo's attack thanks to Sandra, came more as a humiliation than relief.
It was inevitable, as the enemy's seemingly playful behavior somehow turned out to be advantageous.
If it weren't for Yona, if it weren't for Sandra.
This mission would have already been a failure. Rune Candle would have likely been able to escape, but they would have suffered a significant blow without any gains.
'It wasn't just Zieffel and Hedo who were careless. Rune Candle and I also took things too lightly.'
However, now was not the time for regret or self-blame.
The issues could be addressed later, and the humiliation suffered today would be repaid with greater disgrace in the future.
'The fortunate thing is that the enemy didn't fully anticipate these variables.'
In that case, he had to figure out the most unexpected variables now.

'For some reason, Hedo sees Sandra Zieffel's orders as most important. However, it's unlikely that Sandra and I can really have dinner together tonight. If possible, they just want to let me go to avoid Sandra's resentment.'
-If you have anything you took from here, leave it. Then I will spare your life for now.
When Jin guessed the background of Hedo's words, the phrase "I will spare your life for now" bothered him.
'After retrieving the blueprints, Hedo intended to kill everyone except me or me and Murakan.'
Not only Joshua, Diphus, and Jane, but also the wandering souls who had been pitifully hanging around. Jin was certain of it.

'They wanted to kill the wandering souls either to erase the evidence that they prioritized Sandra's orders over the family's, or because they were annoyed. And they called the main force even though I could die... because if it becomes known that we escaped with the ship's blueprints, Sandra might also be affected.'
His head felt like it was about to explode with the successive assumptions.
'Not only Murakan and I, but everyone in Rune Candle must survive. At least until we get out of the second tower!'
Since Draka's main force would be providing support, there would inevitably be a tough battle even after escaping the second tower.
To increase the chances of escaping the Lutero Magic Federation, Yona, Diphus, Jane, and even Joshua had to survive.
'How can I do it? I need a way to negotiate with the tower keeper.'
As he thought that far, Jin saw something familiar through the fleet filling the sky behind Hedo...
He discovered something familiar.
And the word that came to his mind at that moment was this:
Heavenly Cloud.
"Heaven is helping me. No, maybe it was foreseen from the moment they arrived."
Jin immediately concluded how to utilize the newly revealed variable in the sky.
Also, he couldn't miss the opportunity to understand as much as possible about Hedo.
Jin held a knife to Sandra Zipl's throat. Even as the knife touched her neck, she seemed to enjoy getting closer to Jin.
"Make way, tower keeper."
At Jin's words, Hedo shrugged his shoulders.
"Do you plan to take the lady as a hostage? You should know that's meaningless. Haven't you experienced it in the Gaipa Army?"

"Of course, I know that Sandra Zipl is nearly immortal. But hasn't the fact itself not yet been properly exposed to the public? Moreover, the fact that Sandra tried to help me escape wouldn't be good for you or her if it becomes widely known."
"I've said it several times, return the blueprint. Then I will spare your life."
"I keep giving the same answer. I didn't steal anything. And when I said to open the way, I meant not to harm any Rune Kandel present here, not just Murakan and me."
Hedo's gaze hardened.
"Don't you think you're making excessive demands in enemy territory?"
"Even if you block me, I'm confident I can escape with Sandra. Then, can you really control this strange woman's mouth? There must be a limit to media control."
"You're crossing the line."
"Even if we engage in fierce battles during the escape, Sandra won't die, so her near-immortality is actually an advantageous condition for us now."
"You're speaking confidently, but you surely know that escaping the Lutero Magic Federation with the lady is impossible. Just leave with Murakan."
Jin firmly shook his head.
"I'll say it one last time. Make way, tower keeper."
Annoyed, Hedo took out a cigarette and smoked.

'12th generation needs insurance in many ways because of their obsession with the lady. But why is he insisting even though he knows I can't evade the pursuit of the main force? I thought he wasn't such a foolish person.'
Whether Hedo let them pass or not, all the Rune Kandels here would face death if heaven did not favor them....
Hedo had thought so since he called the main force.
The reason he tried to kill the others, except Jin and Murakan, was because he needed justification.
He needed something to say when questioned by Kellyak later. Even though he let his guard down and missed Jin and Murakan, he claimed to have killed all the others.
"Um, darling."
Sandra, who had been happily staring at Jin's side profile, opened her mouth.

"I roughly understand why you're doing this. You hate that damned musclehead, right? Today, I really want to tear him to pieces. How dare he put you in danger... But, shouldn't we consider Hedo's position a little?"
Surprisingly, she accurately read all the hidden flow between Jin and Hedo's conversation. The fact that Jin needed insurance and Hedo needed justification.
However, she hadn't noticed the change in the sky because she was only admiring Jin's side profile.

"If we all escape safely, not only Hedo but also I will have a hard time being completely unharmed. I'll definitely be pursued. You don't want that, right? Our married life hasn't even properly started yet, and if I get stuck in a place like a family torture chamber, Jin will be sad, right?"
"An underground torture chamber? I don't think you'll end up in a place like that."
"Shut up, Hedo! I'm trying to fix this!"
Sandra, who shouted in an annoyed manner, grinned and turned her gaze back to Jin.

"So, let's just leave with me and the Black Dragon, the three of us peacefully. That way, you can almost certainly survive. I'll be the bait. Then no one gets hurt, right? We'll even have a date called an escape play!"
It seemed she didn't even classify the remaining Rune Kandels as people, except for Jin.
Instead of responding to her words, Jin exchanged glances with Hedo.
"Tower keeper, you still don't understand why I'm so insistent."
Jin pointed to the sky behind Hedo with his finger.
"If you look at that, you'll think that accepting my proposal wouldn't be so bad."
Hedo turned around.
In the sky, there were over a hundred Zipl flying transport ships, but strangely, only one was illuminated.
It wasn't a Zipl ship.
The warship Gruenil.
The flagship of Kinzelo that had attacked the Black Imperial Star.
The cannons of Gruenil were aiming at the stationary transport ships.
"Wouldn't it be better to let us go and block that thing? There couldn't be a better justification for you and your lady."
Jin smiled, and Hedo crushed his cigarette with a grimace.
